capabilities: wrap editor tabs into multiple rows with automatic width fitting
scroll tab rows with the mouse wheel and a native scrollbar
drag tabs within a window and between separate Obsidian windows
adjust tab widths, row height, wheel speed, edge scrolling, and scrollbar width
restore individual settings or all defaults
disambiguation: Not just mouse-wheel scrolling; the plugin itself provides the multiline tab layout and tab dragging.
extras: Desktop-only: cross-window tab dragging depends on Obsidian's desktop workspace windows. Notes the built-in layout replaces the separate multiline-tabs-autofit.css snippet and that it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's tab bar is single-row, so many open tabs overflow or shrink and hard to reach.
summary: Desktop plugin that wraps editor tabs into multiple rows with wheel scrolling, resizable layout, and cross-window tab dragging.
